questions.stem: Which of the following statements regarding post-dural puncture headache (PDPH) is false?

options.label: A
options.text: PDPH typically presents with a dull, throbbing headache aggravated by sitting or standing.

options.label: B
options.text: The incidence of PDPH is higher with larger gauge needles used for lumbar puncture.

options.label: C
options.text: PDPH is caused by leakage of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) from the dural puncture site.

options.label: D
options.text: PDPH is more commonly seen in patients with a history of migraine headaches.
